meta.title: Two bids on two lines: award line-wise: line 1 to B, line 2 to A; approver rejects
gaps: A closed RFQ with two line items and two vendor bids with the specified quantities and prices
Allocating line 1 to Vendor B and line 2 to Vendor A with quantities 10 and 5
Verifying Vendor B totals 10 × 90 = 900, Vendor A totals 5 × 50 = 250, and the combined total is 1,150
Filling and submitting the proposal for the specified two-line allocation
Signing in as the approver and rejecting the proposal with a remark
Verifying that no purchase order is created after rejection
Verifying that the buyer can start awarding again after the approver rejection
